player_prompt.intro:
Ko a yi Jokkere {player_id} caggal nder GameOfPureStrategy.
- A hawti kerti 13 A-K; koo haɗe ɗum haɗe so.
- Kala dow a yi kerti kuugal ngal wiyi. Kuugal so kerti gooto caggal wallude tana daɗe ɗum '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Kerti ɓurɗum ngari yi kuugal ngal (e ɓaawo ɗeɓɓe). Kala ɓuri ɓaawo pot ngal dow heeɓa.
- Ɓurɗo ɓurɗum ngari ɓaawo dow 13 yi nasara.
